parties: ITA 8000 - Anita Neri Sofia Jasmine Kay
procedural_matters: TOMAŠ ILENČIK COACH attended the hearing as an observer for SVK 4922 MATEO FOCACCIA COACH ITA attended the hearing as an observer for ITA 8000 Martin Clasen gave evidence as a witness for JURY. Fiorella Nicolari gave evidence as a witness for JURY. Anita Neri gave evidence as a witness for ITA 8000. Juraj Vozar gave evidence as a witness for SVK 4922.
facts: WIND CONDITIONS: MORE THAN 15 KTS, WAVES HALF METER HEIGHT.
SVK 4922 ON STARBOARD INSIDE, ITA 8000 ON PORT OUTSIDE, IN THE ZONE OF MARK 3P ON COLLISION COURSE.
BOTH BOATS WERE ROUNDING THE MARK WITH 1.5 METER DISTANCE BETWEEN THE BOATS.
BOTH BOATS LEFT THE MARK ASTERN.
IMMEDIATELY THEREAFTER ITA 8000 BOW HIT BELOW THE TOP OF THE MAST OF SVK 4922.
DAMAGE OCCURED ON MAINSSAIL, BELOW THE TOP BATTEN OF SVK 4922.
ITA 8000 BORE AWAY AND BOATS HAVE BEEN SEPARATED.
SVK 4922 LOST THREE PLACES IN THE RANK.
NO BOAT TOOK A PENALTY TURN.
conclusions: SVK 4922 to windward failed to keep clear of ITA 8000 to leeward, and broke RRS 11.
It was not reasonably possible for ITA 8000 the right-of-way boat to avoid contact with SVK 4922 when it became clear that SVK 4922 was not keeping clear. ITA 8000 did not break RRS 14(a).
SVK 4922 caused contact between SVK 4922 and ITA 8000 even though it was reasonably possible to avoid causing it, and broke RRS 14(b).
